evals.prompt: Revise enterprise-standard clauses whose current text conflicts with a binding regulator requirement, so mandatory, recommended, and informative statements are unambiguous and verifiable.
evals.expected_output: Clause-level replacement text grounded in the governing drafting rules and verified references.
assertions: Vague verbs and unverifiable adjectives are replaced
Each material change identifies its authority or evidence level
The target text is treated as the object under revision, not as proof of its own authority

evals.prompt: The cited standard is inaccessible. Improve the clause without pretending to know the cited clause text.
evals.expected_output: A bounded revision based on available authority, with the inaccessible dependency marked for confirmation.
assertions: Inaccessible normative text is not invented
The proposed wording stays within known authority

evals.prompt: Revise a clause whose cited edition may be superseded and whose conformity method is undefined.
evals.expected_output: A clause revision that bounds authority by jurisdiction and edition and supplies or flags a verifiable conformity method.
assertions: Edition and supersession status are verified or bounded
Conformity evidence and responsibility are defined or marked unresolved
